book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Ekerenjo chu ubhuryakari
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kwija Abhafarisaayo na abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani kokerenjo ɨkɨndɨ akabhuga,
“Ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ bhutuubhɨɨnɨ nʉ ʉmʉtɨmi wʉnʉ akʉrirɨ ubhuryakari bhu umwana waazɨ.
Akatʉma bhambʉʉsa bhaazɨ bhajɨ kʉbhɨrɨkɨra bhanʉ aarɨ araarikirɨ kubhuryakari, nawe bhʉʉsi bhakaanga kuuza.

“Neho akatʉma bhambʉʉsa abhandɨ, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, ‘Mujɨ mʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ bhanʉ naraarikirɨ, “Nɨkʉrirɨ ubhuryakari bhwanɨ. Nisinzirɨ zengʼombe zaanɨ zinuru hamwɨmwɨ ni imitugʉ ɨgɨndɨ iminuru. Na bhyʉsi bhɨbhɨɨrɨ, muuzɨ kubhuryakari!”’
Nawe abhaatʉ bhanʉ bharaarikirwɨ, bhakaregana. Bhakaja komeremo jabhʉ, abhandɨ bhakaja mʉmʉgʉndʉ, na abhandɨ bhakaja kusuruja.
Abhandɨ bhakagwata bhambʉʉsa bhʉ ʉmʉtɨmi, bhakabhatema na kubhiita.
Mmbe, hanʉ ʉmʉtɨmi iigwirɨ ganʉ gakʉriibhwɨ kwa abhahocha bhaazɨ, akiigatana bhʉkʉngʼu. Akatʉma abhasirikarɨ bhaazɨ bharichɨ abhiiti bharya na kwocha ʉrʉbhɨri rwabhʉ.
“Akʉmara ʉmʉtɨmi wuyo akabhʉʉrɨra bhambʉʉsa bhaazɨ, ‘Ebhegero bhyʉsi bhyu ubhuryakari bhɨmarirɨ kokorwa, nawe abharaarikwa bhataarɨ bhareenderwa kuuza.
Mmbe nangʉ, mujɨ kʉnzɨra ya amahʉkana, mʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ bhʉbhʉʉsi bhanʉ mukurumana nabhʉ, bhaazɨ kubhuryakari.’
Bhambʉʉsa bhayo bhakaja kʉnzɨra, bhakagarʉka na abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaabharʉʉzɨ, abhabhɨ na abhazʉmu. Bhakasikɨra mwibhuru ryu ubhuryakari kuhika rikiizʉra.
“Nawe hanʉ ʉmʉtɨmi aasikiirɨ mwibhuru ryi isigukuru korereke arore abhagini, akarora ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ wʉnʉ atiibhʉhirɨ engebho yu ubhuryakari.
Akamubhuurya, ‘Mʉsaani waanɨ, ʉkasikɨrabhwɨ mʉnʉ, ɨnʉ utiibhʉhirɨ engebho yu ubhuryakari?’ Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo akakira.
Mmbe, ʉmʉtɨmi akabhʉʉrɨra abhahocha bhaazɨ, ‘Momobhohe amagʉrʉ na amabhoko, morekere igʉtʉ mukiirimya. Iyo bhararɨra na kokepeha.’ ”
Yɨɨsu akamariirya kwa kʉgamba, “Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakubhirikirwa kusikɨra mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa mwisaarʉ, nɨ‑bhaaru, nawe bhanʉ bharʉbhwɨrwɨ kusikɨra, nɨ‑bhasuuhu.”
Yɨɨsu arabhuuribhwa igʉrʉ wʉ ʉkʉrɨha rigʉʉti
Mmbe, Abhafarisaayo bhakiibhiringa kʉgambana chɨmbu bharaahaatyɨ Yɨɨsu kwa amangʼana gaazɨ.
Akʉmara bhakatʉma abhɨɨga bhaabhʉ hamwɨmwɨ na abhasakirya bha riribhita ryʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Heroode Antipaasi
kwa Yɨɨsu. Hanʉ bhaahikirɨ bhakabhuurya Yɨɨsu, “Umwija, tʉmɨnyirɨ kʉbha awɨ nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ we eheene na uriija amaheene igʉrʉ wa amangʼana ga Mungu. Ʉtakwʉbhaha wʉwʉʉsi, nʉʉrʉ abhɨ nu umweya gwi igʉrʉ.
Nangʉ ʉtʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ awɨ ʉrarorabhwɨ. Kʉrɨngʼaana ni imigirʉ ja Musa, toreenderwa kʉrɨha rigʉʉti kwa Kaisaari,
kisha zɨyi?”
Nawe Yɨɨsu akamenya ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ, akabhagarukirya, “Abhabhɨɨhi imwɨ, kwakɨ mʉrangema?
Monyeereche rizenzere rɨnʉ mʉkʉrɨhɨra rigʉʉti.” Bhʉʉsi bhakamoha rizenzere rɨmwɨ.
Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Ipicha yɨnʉ ni riina rɨnʉ, ni‑bhya wɨɨwɨ?”
Bhakamʉgarukirya, “Bhya Kaisaari.” Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Bhya Kaisaari mohe Kaisaari, na bhya Mungu mohe Mungu.”
Hanʉ bhiigwirɨbhu, bhakarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu. Bhakamutiga, bhakabhʉʉka bhakaja.
Yɨɨsu ariija igʉrʉ wu ukuryʉka abhaku
Urusikʉ ruyoruyo, Abhasadukaayo obhorebhe bhakaaza kwa Yɨɨsu. Abhasadukaayo bhahiija kʉbha Mungu atahaaryʉra abhaatʉ kurwa muruku. Neho bhakabhuurya Yɨɨsu,
“Umwija, Musa akabhuga mumigirʉ jazɨ, arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ akuurɨ akɨɨrɨ kwibhʉra umwana, ereenderwa umuhiiri waazɨ agabhɨ ʉmʉkari wu umuku wuyo, korereke amwibhʉrɨrɨ abhaana.
Mmbe, bhaareho abhahiiri muhungatɨ. We embere akakwɨra ʉmʉkari, akakwa akɨɨrɨ kwibhʉra. Umuhiiri waazɨ wa kabhɨrɨ akamʉgabha umukwirwa wuyo.
Umunyi waazɨ wuyo na wa katatʉ bhʉʉsi bhakakwa bhakɨɨrɨ kwibhʉra umwana nu umukwirwa wuyo. Ɨkabha ɨbhuɨbhu kʉbhahiiri muhungatɨ bhayo bhʉʉsi, bhakakwa bhakɨɨrɨ kwibhʉra.
Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, ʉmʉkari wuyo wʉʉsi akakwa.
Mmbe tʉbhʉʉrɨrɨ, urusikʉ rʉnʉ rʉkʉgambwa kʉbha abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhararyʉka, umukwirwa wuyo arabha mʉka wɨɨwɨ? Muhungatɨ bhayo bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bhamukwɨrirɨ!”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Imwɨ mʉrarimɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, kʉ kʉbha mʉtɨɨzɨ Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu naabha ʉbhʉnaja bhwa Mungu.
Urusikʉ rʉnʉ abhaatʉ bhakuryʉka, bharabha ncha bhamaraika bha mwisaarʉ, bhatakukwɨra naabha kukwɨrwa.
Nawe igʉrʉ wu ukuryʉka kwa abhaku, mʉkɨɨrɨ kosoma mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu chɨmbu Mungu aabhabhuuriirɨ? Akabhuga,
‘Inyɨ ni‑Mungu wa Abhurahaamu, Iisaka na Yaakobho.’
” Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Mmbe, Mungu nɨ‑wa abhahʉru, atarɨ Mungu wa abhaku.”
Hanʉ riribhita rya abhaatʉ bhiigwirɨ gayo, bhakarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu kwa amiija gaazɨ.
Riswaja rikʉrʉ kʉkɨra gʉʉsi
Hanʉ Abhafarisaayo bhiigwirɨ kʉbha Yɨɨsu aarɨ ahizirɨ Abhasadukaayo kʉbhʉgambi bhwazɨ, bhakiibhiringa hamwɨmwɨ.
Akʉmara, bhakaja kwa Yɨɨsu, na wʉmwɨ waabhʉ wʉnʉ aarɨ umwija wi imigirʉ ja Musa, akagema komotega. Akamubhuurya,
“Umwija, ni‑iswajakɨ rikʉrʉ kʉkɨra amaswaja agandɨ gʉʉsi ga Mungu?”
Yɨɨsu akamʉgarukirya, “‘Ʉmʉsɨɨgɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu waazʉ kumwʉyʉ gwazʉ gwʉsi, kokoro yaazʉ yʉʉsi na kʉmangʼɨɨni gaazʉ gʉʉsi.’
Riswaja rɨnʉ neryo rikʉrʉ kʉkɨra amaswaja agandɨ gʉʉsi, naatu nego ganu ubhwɨndi kʉkɨra gʉʉsi.
Ubhuswaja bhwa kabhɨrɨ bhutuubhɨɨnɨ na bhuyo, nabhwɨ bhʉrabhuga, ‘Ʉmʉsɨɨgɨ nyarʉbhɨri waazʉ chɨmbu wisɨɨgirɨ aumwene.’
Imigirʉ jʉsi ja Musa na amiija ga abharʉʉtɨrɨri bhiriisega amaswaja abhɨrɨ gayo.”
Yɨɨsu arabhuurya Abhafarisaayo igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ
Hanʉ Abhafarisaayo bhayo bhaarɨ bhakɨɨrɨ bhiibhiringirɨ hamwɨmwɨ hayo, Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya,
“Muriiseegabhwɨ igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ, ni‑mwana wa wɨɨwɨ?” Bhakamʉgarukirya, “Ni‑mwana wʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Arɨɨbhɨ gayo nɨ‑ga amaheene, kwakɨ Daudi, hanʉ akʉkangatwa ne Ekoro ya Mungu, aramʉbhɨrɨkɨra Kiriisitʉ, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ’? Akabhuga,

content.text: hanʉ nɨkʉtʉʉra abhabhisa bhaazʉ iyaasɨ wa amagʉrʉ gaazʉ.” ’

content: Arɨɨbhɨ Daudi aramʉbhɨrɨkɨra Kiriisitʉ, ‘Ʉmʉkʉrʉ,’ nangʉ Kiriisitʉ aratʉrabhwɨ kʉbha umwana waazɨ naatu?”
Mmbe, atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aaturirɨ kʉmʉgarukirya ryʉryʉsi. Naatu kʉtangɨra hayo, atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aagɨmirɨ kubhuurya Yɨɨsu amabhuurya agandɨ.

footnotes.text: Abhasakirya bha riribhita ryʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Heroode Antipaasi kuKigiriki nɨ‑Bhaheroode. Abhaatʉ bhayo bhakiisirirya ʉbhʉkangati bhwa Abharuumi mucharʉ chabhʉ. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana Heroode Antipaasi muKiniibhasa.
Kaisaari aarɨ nɨ‑mʉtɨmi wa Abharuumi, naatu newe aakangatirɨ icharʉ cha Iziraɨri kwibhaga rirya. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
